lines.en: Okay, the turkey's in the oven, the stuffing is ready.
You know, you always cook this meal all by yourself.
But you don't have to do everything Dr. Phil tells you to do.
I'm serious. Let me do something.
Just not the turkey or the stuffing.
It's easy to make and no one really cares about it.
Okay, I'm gonna go check on something across the hall.
You obviously haven't tasted my Paul Mala potatoes.
